CONTROLS.NAME: colored
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change from pure white to one of three color palettes, with color palettes changing on transition.

CONTROLS.NAME: invert
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle between white on black or black on white.

CONTROLS.NAME: motion_style
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Two motion modes for the main shape: ON is a poppy motion that moves on the beat. When set to OFF it creates a slower moving, oscillating mandala.

CONTROLS.NAME: radius_ring
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes the radius of individual rings. Thin is an interesting look. Can be set very low for disappearing rings.

CONTROLS.NAME: blur_amount
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Applies blur to the rings, reducing hard edges. Can be turned way up to 'blow up' the scene.

CONTROLS.NAME: aberration
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Control amount of chromatic aberration. The middle is 'none', top and bottom are full aberration amount in opposite directions.

CONTROLS.NAME: refraction
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Control amount of refraction through triangle surface. High refraction results in pretty colors but can lead to FPS lag. Bottom is none, top is full.

CONTROLS.NAME: surface_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a pulse through the triangle surface, shuffling around refracted light.

CONTROLS.NAME: surface_fracture
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Fracture the triangle surface, as if it had been shattered by a hit.
